docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The wood-engraver who climbed the Matterhorn tells of his first ascents in the Alps, and of the disaster on the descent.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Edward Whymper (1840–1911), Scrambles amongst the Alps in the Years 1860–69, 1871. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Wikisource. Modified: converted to this format.
